reveal_fog_of_war: reveal fog of war on a top-down map by drawing lines from the agent position within its field of view
bresenham_supercover_line: compute all grid points along a line between two coordinates using the Bresenham supercover algorithm
draw_fog_of_war_line: draw a visibility line on the fog of war mask between two points stopping at walls
test_reveal_fog_of_war: test the reveal_fog_of_war function with a sample top-down map and agent position to verify visibility
refactor_bresenham_supercover_line: refactor the bresenham_supercover_line function to support floating point coordinates instead of integers
